description: Spun off from Exelon in 2022, Constellation Energy is a major U.S. power generator and retailer, offering electricity, natural gas, and sustainable energy solutions through a diverse portfolio that includes nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. The company operates across several key regions, with its generation fleet totaling over 32,400 megawatts. Constellation serves a wide range of customers, including utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential clients. Strategic investments in nuclear plant upgrades, clean energy projects, and long-term power purchase agreements—such as the Crane Clean Energy Center and partnerships with technology firms—position the company to meet rising demand from data centers and more.

title: Constellation Energy

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"One of the things that makes Constellation a truly great place to work is the flexibility and support it provides remote employees. As a military spouse, being able to relocate across the country and still remain fully engaged in my role has been invaluable. Even while moving states, I've continued to grow professionally. That kind of continuity and opportunity, regardless of location, is rare -- and it speaks volumes about the company's commitment to retaining and investing in its people."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say: 

"What's unique about this company is both the passion and mission set forth from the top. You find employees across the company with a passion for going above and beyond to 1) do their job and 2) help support others in doing their job as needed. The mission of our company to be the leader in producing carbon-free energy is also about making the world a better place for the future, and volunteering/supporting our communities go hand in hand with that. When you have a community of people that prioritize a future of giving back and making the world a better place for future generations, you have kind and caring employees that feel supported."
